name: tidy-loop
description: Scheduled structure-only refactoring loop: one hotspot finding per run, verified against behavior-preservation gates, delivered as a draft PR.

interface.shortDescription: Weekly structure-only refactoring runs, gated on behavior preservation, delivered as draft PRs.
interface.longDescription: A scheduled loop that keeps a codebase's structure healthy without changing its behavior. It ranks hotspots by churn and size, proposes one structural finding per run, works in an isolated git worktree, and opens a draft pull request only when every gate passes — including a base-test gate that runs the test files from the base commit against the refactored source. Ships zero project facts: everything project-specific lives in the consuming repo's committed .tidyloop.yaml.
